study: Schoen et al. 2020, Cognitively Guided Instruction (CGI), Year 1 (FCR-STEM/FSU)
eval_evidence: Report states it 'involves a third-party evaluation of a highly regarded PD program (CGI)... designed and implemented by Teachers Development Group (TDG)'; IES grant to FSU, eval team distinct from the program deliverer.
developer_evidence: TDG (Teachers Development Group) facilitators designed and delivered the CGI PD; the FSU/FCR-STEM authors are the third-party evaluators, not the PD deliverers.
cascade_evidence: 'Three facilitators delivered the workshops' from TDG (the program-delivery organization) directly to the participating grade 1-2 teachers; no train-the-trainer hop.
counterfactual_evidence: Comparison schools were invited to participate in a different district-chosen PD program (active alternative PD that did not target number/operations/algebraic thinking).
coaching_evidence: 8 workshop days/year: a 4-day summer workshop plus two two-day follow-up sessions, each including one 'classroom-embedded workshop day' where facilitators observed and discussed a classroom lesson; periodic classroom-embedded support, not recurring monthly in-class coaching cycles.
student_dose_evidence: CGI changes the teacher's regular mathematics instruction; no separate student tutoring/pull-out or added instructional dose.
maturity_evidence: Explicitly the 'First Program Year' — outcomes (spring 2014) measured at the end of the first year of CGI implementation, Year 1 of a 3-year model (teachers new to it).
